question: Q-004
reason: The criterion is satisfied as it stands. ServersPage keeps the view before the approval, feeds it and the approve answer to changedRefs with the approved surface's effects, and mounts RefCarryPanel inside the Surface section only after a successful approval. The panel returns nothing when refNoticeText is null, so a first approval (null refs before) shows no text and no button and reads no grants. The notice is a tools-note paragraph, the button carries the fixed name, and carryGrants runs only in the press handler, so nothing is requested before the press. carryGrants reads all grants first and rejects before any post, which the panel renders as ErrorPanel, an alert that shows the 403 decision id. The list is a ul named Copied grants, the Deploy on Policies link goes to /admin/policies only when a grant was created, a grant whose effect changed is listed and never posted, and no code path sends DELETE, PUT or PATCH. The three tests in e2e/test_m8_ref_carry.py assert each of these observable results exactly as test-plan-browser.md § Approve lists them.

question: Q-005
reason: The criterion is satisfied as it stands. The Grants page reads GET /tool-servers through loadAllToolServers with a plain API client beside its other reads; the page reader asks for limit 100 and passes each page's cursor, so two pages give two hits, the second with cursor s2. Each row renders RefMarker right after grantTextWithBadge inside the same span, and RefMarker is a span with data-slot ref-marker and data-state that renders nothing for current or null, so the status Badge stays the row's only badge slot. refState gives superseded for ledger.create_payment@1 against the approved ledger listing @2, waiting for acme.lookup_vendor@1 against the drifted acme listing the same ref, current for ledger.create_payment@2 and null for crm.find_customer@1 because crm lists no tool of that name. The e2e test asserts exactly these markers, badges and server queries.

question: Q-006
reason: The criterion is satisfied as it stands. The servers read on the Grants page uses a plain API client whose fetch is the global one, so the 401 session-end handler that only the session client wraps around its fetch never runs and the URL stays on /admin/grants. The read's rejection handler is empty and the servers state starts as an empty list, so a 403, 500 or 401 leaves no marker, adds no alert and changes nothing else on the page: the rows keep their text and one Badge each. In the error state the two pre-existing alerts (the tool list's ErrorPanel and the table's) remain the only ones, the Tool select keeps only Choose a tool, and the busy form keeps Create grant aria-disabled. The three e2e tests assert each of these results.

question: Q-010
reason: The hold may be waived.
